desc:
Start your adventure on a small island floating above the endless void. Collect resources, craft tools, and expand your world as you discover new islands. Travel through a mysterious portal to uncover the Underworld!

⛏️ Mine valuable materials, farm crops, and upgrade your equipment.
🏝️ Venture into snowy mountains, underground mines, and ancient desert ruins.
🔥 Enter the Underworld and explore the remains of a forgotten outpost.
👍 If you enjoyed the game, show your support by liking and favoriting!
